title: ctenopteris myriophylla
intro: Ctenopteris myriophylla, commonly known as Maidenhair Tree Fern, is a plant species native to New Zealand. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which provide health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Ctenopteris myriophylla include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and coughs, as well as its antiseptic properties to aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
